review_notes: The file has one theorem, `replicaGibbsMass_tail`. It shows that the Gibbs mass of a set of replica configurations pulled back along `Fin.tail` equals the mass of the set. It adds no definitions or structures, so it introduces no competing version of an existing Mathlib concept. The proof already uses Mathlib's `Fin.consEquiv`, `Fintype.sum_equiv` and `Fintype.sum_prod_type`. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening. I did not open the definitions of `replicaGibbsMass` or `gibbs`, which live in other files, because the rubric does not apply to this file's content.
